product_summary: Ceracin (Vadodara, Gujarat; incorporated 2016; unit at 316-317 Krishna Gold, Maneja, Makarpura) is a manufacturer of industrial liquid-handling pumps. Real product lines listed on ceracin.com/our-products/ and the site navigation: (1) Air Operated Double Diaphragm (AODD) pumps in PP, PVDF, SS and aluminium bodies, plus powder-transfer and hygienic AODD versions; (2) electric diaphragm pumps; (3) dosing/metering pumps — electronic dosing, motorised dosing, diaphragm metering, plunger/piston; (4) barrel/drum pumps — hand drum pump, air-operated and electric drum pumps; (5) eccentric screw / progressive cavity pumps, horizontal and single screw pumps, screw dosing pumps; (6) magnetic drive pumps; (7) valves — PVDF ball valves, diaphragm valves; (8) accessories/instrumentation — pH probes and sensors, polymer preparation units, chemical injection systems.
role_hint: manufacturer (site states own 8000 sq ft manufacturing unit in Vadodara and 'manufacturers of Pumps'; no trader/reseller signs found; no third-party brand resale observed). Note: 'Exporters India' appears only as a page-title/SEO string, not as evidence of export activity.
comment: HS 841381 ('Pumps for liquids, whether or not fitted with a measuring device: other pumps') is broadly correct for the core AODD, magnetic drive and screw/PC pump lines — hence partial, not wrong. However the declaration is too narrow for the actual catalogue: (a) dosing/metering pumps with measuring devices and chemical injection systems belong to 8413.19 (fuel/lubricating/measuring-device pumps) rather than 8413.81; (b) diaphragm metering and plunger/piston dosing pumps may fall under 8413.50 (reciprocating positive-displacement) depending on configuration; (c) screw/progressive-cavity pumps are 8413.60 (rotary positive-displacement), not 8413.81; (d) PVDF ball valves and diaphragm valves are 8481.80 (taps, cocks, valves) — a separate chapter entirely, missing from the declaration; (e) pH probes/sensors and polymer preparation units are instrumentation (9027.80 / 8479.82 respectively) and are not pumps at all. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a misclassification: the company is a general industrial pump/fluid-handling equipment maker serving chemicals, fertiliser, power and process plants (testimonials cite GSECL Sikka Thermal Power Plant, IFFCO, Yash High-voltage Ltd) — not a metals or mining producer. No customs line was available to me in this task, so all product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared on own website, not corroborated by a shipment record). No PAN/CIN or revenue data researched per role scope; not public in the sources read.
